description: Use Aixio’s own Image to Layer model to turn images into editable layers, with complementary image, video and audio generation.

interface.longDescription: Aixio Image to Layer is Aixio’s own model for turning an uploaded image into editable image and text layers. Use it with your agent to work with posters, campaign graphics and diagrams. Results include layer positions, stacking order and available text/font properties; the plugin reports partial results, flattened fallbacks and failures accurately. Complementary image, video, audio and text models are available through the live catalog to support your workflow. Sign in to your Aixio account to use your available model entitlements. Track long-running work by job ID.
